title: Check a batch of invoices against a budget, to the cent
heading: A Float Holds About 16 Significant Digits, So Most Decimals Are Rounded
cases: a batch whose total is the budget fits, though its float sum is a little above it, and a batch 5 cents over does not
an amount times 100 can land just below a whole number of cents, so it is rounded, not cut
a total one cent above the budget does not fit, so no tolerance as large as a cent is allowed
